effects.target: direct observers and individuals within an uncertain distance

evidence.locator: SCP-3000 is a Class VIII cognitohazardous entity; direct observation of SCP-3000 may cause severe mental alterations in viewers.

effects.trigger: after the total consumption of prey

evidence.locator: At a point after the total consumption of prey, SCP-3000 will begin to excrete Y-909 near the foremost section of its body.

constraints: Y-909 is refined and included in amnestics
a synthetic version of the compound has not yet been discovered

evidence.locator: The inclusion of the Y-909 compound has shown a marked increase in the stability and long-term effectiveness of the aforementioned amnestics.

effects.trigger: There is currently no known cure for exposure to SCP-3000
constraints: an individual is affected by SCP-3000

evidence.locator: There is currently no known cure for exposure to SCP-3000; as such, affected individuals should be contained and quarantined for further evaluation.
